```{r}
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(1)
```

# Question 1
```{r}
bday_sim = function(n) {
  birthdays = sample(1:365, size = n, replace = T)
  if (n_distinct(birthdays) < n) {
    T
  } else {
    F
  }
}
bday_sim(2)
bday_sim(50)
```

```{r}
sim_results_df =
  expand_grid(
    group_size = 2:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |>
  mutate(
    shared_bday = map(group_size, bday_sim)
  ) |>
  unnest(shared_bday)

head(sim_results_df)
```

```{r}
sim_summary = 
  sim_results_df |> 
  group_by(group_size) |> 
  summarize(prob_shared = mean(shared_bday))

head(sim_summary)
```

```{r}
sim_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(group_size, prob_shared)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Probability of Shared Birthday by Group Size",
       x = "group size",
       y = "probability") +
  theme_classic()
```
The probability intitially near 0, but rises quickly at first as the group size increases. it levels off near 1 as the group size increases and passes 50% at just under 25 people. 

# Question 2
```{r}
all_df = 
  tibble(files = list.files("data/"),
         path = str_c("data/", files)
  )

all_df =
  all_df |>
  mutate(data = map(path, read_csv)) |>
  unnest(cols = "data")
```

```{r}
tidy_df = 
  all_df |> 
  mutate(
    files = str_replace(files, ".csv", ""), 
    arm = str_sub(files, 1, 3),
    subj_id = str_sub(files, 5, 6)
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    week_1:week_8,
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "observation",
    names_prefix = "week_"
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = as.numeric(week)) |> 
  select(id = files, arm, subj_id, week, observation)

head(tidy_df)
```

```{r}
tidy_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = observation, group = id, color = arm)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(~arm) +
  labs(
    title = "Observations Over Time by Subject, by Study Arm",
    x = "week",
    y = "observation",
    color = "arm"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
The control arm shows no trends, but the experimental arm seems to have an upwards trend with the lines between 3.5 and 7 by week 8.
